$comment: The colour theme picker: Settings → Theme (app/(tabs)/settings/theme.tsx) and the theme step of the welcome flow (components/ThemePicker.tsx).

title.note: Settings row and screen title; the colour theme of the app.

light.note: VoiceOver label of the light-mode preview tile of a theme.

dark.note: VoiceOver label of the dark-mode preview tile of a theme.

appearance.$comment: Settings → Theme, a segmented control above the list: whether the theme follows the iPhone's light/dark setting or stays on one side.

auto.note: Follow the iPhone's appearance. Segment label; keep short.

light.note: Always the light side. Segment label.

dark.note: Always the dark side. Segment label.

title.note: Section header above the row of home-screen icons on Settings → Theme.

a11y.note: VoiceOver label of one icon in that row; name is a theme name.

name.$comment: Theme names: every theme is named after a cat. Write the names as they sound.

graphite.note: The default theme, graphite grey on off-white (and the reverse in dark mode), named after a cat called Pusik.

siri.note: A theme named after a grey-fawn tabby cat called Siri: warm grey with a terracotta accent. A cat's name, not Apple's assistant.

tadeusz.note: A theme named after two ginger cats, Tadeusz and Kastuś: cream and ginger. Two cats' names joined by 'and'.

catppuccin.note: A theme named after a cat called Una: soft lavender and pastels (the Catppuccin palette).
